{{Top|leg}}
'''Keysshi''' was the name of the ancient [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] ceremony of History. It was a public ceremony in which a clan celebrated and shared stories of the History of the Twi'leks and in particular, the history of the clan. This ceremony was used as a means of passing down tradition prior to written language. Tales stated that the ceremony was presided over by a [[Unidentified crystal skull|crystal skull]] carved from the crystallized ashes of the [[Jedi Lord]] [[Newar Forrth]], ruler and protector of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].
